description: This file defines the OrganizationWatchlistQueryService class, which provides methods to list and retrieve details of watchlist entries for an organization, including permission checks and user data enrichment.

classes.name: OrganizationWatchlistQueryService
classes.description: Service class for querying organization watchlist entries with permission checks and user data enrichment.

methods.name: checkReadPermission
methods.description: Checks if a user has permission to read the watchlist for a given organization.

methods.name: listWatchlistEntries
methods.description: Lists watchlist entries for an organization, including user info for the latest audit.

methods.name: getWatchlistEntryDetails
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific watchlist entry, including audit history and user info.
